def model_fn(model_dir):
    net = SegmentationNet(num_classes=21)
    bundle = torch.load(os.path.join(model_dir, "model.pth"),
                        map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    net.load_state_dict(bundle["state_dict"])
    net.eval()
    return net

def dpo_from_votes(votes_table, policy, ref_model, tok):
    pairs = votes_table.query("SELECT prompt, upvoted, downvoted FROM response_votes")
    ds = Dataset.from_list([
        {"prompt": p, "chosen": up, "rejected": down} for p, up, down in pairs])
    trainer = DPOTrainer(model=policy, ref_model=ref_model, args=DPO_ARGS,
                         train_dataset=ds, processing_class=tok)
    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model("policy-dpo-weekly")

def tune_retriever_from_feedback(feedback_rows, encoder):
    examples = [InputExample(texts=[r.query, r.passage])
                for r in feedback_rows if r.marked_helpful]
    loader = DataLoader(examples, shuffle=True, batch_size=32)
    loss = losses.MultipleNegativesRankingLoss(encoder)
    encoder.fit(train_objectives=[(loader, loss)], epochs=1)
    encoder.save("retriever-ft-latest")

def train_review_sentiment(crawl_dir="crawler_output/reviews"):
    df = pd.concat(pd.read_parquet(p) for p in Path(crawl_dir).glob("*.parquet"))
    df["label"] = (df["stars"] >= 4).astype(int)
    pipe = make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 2)), LogisticRegression())
    pipe.fit(df["review_text"], df["label"])
    return pipe

def process_appeals(appeals, moderation_model, preprocess):
    imgs, ys = [], []
    for a in appeals:
        imgs.append(preprocess(Image.open(a.image_path)))
        ys.append(0)
    x = torch.stack(imgs)
    y = torch.tensor(ys)
    finetune_steps(moderation_model, x, y, epochs=2)
    torch.save(moderation_model.state_dict(), "moderation_latest.pt")

def rebuild_query_lm(query_log_path="logs/search_queries.log"):
    with open(query_log_path) as fh:
        queries = [line.strip().lower().split() for line in fh if line.strip()]
    train, vocab = padded_everygram_pipeline(3, queries)
    lm = MLE(3)
    lm.fit(train, vocab)
    with open("query_lm.json", "w") as out:
        json.dump(export_ngram_counts(lm), out)
